nodes.statement:
A real CPM cell coupled to a real spatio-flux nutrient field through one typed
process (`CpmCellField`) closes the paper's §Cell–environment coupling sense/act loop (Fig 5)
as genuine spatial metabolism: it
runs dynamic-FBA at its own footprint and grows both biologically (biomass) and structurally
(CPM lattice volume). Confirmed: biomass 0.1 -> ~0.37, CPM volume 32 -> 110 px (~3.4x) over
20 ticks, on a 3600-pixel lattice the cell occupies only ~3% of by the end.

nodes.label: The cell measurably depletes the local nutrient it senses before diffusion pa...
nodes.statement:
The cell measurably depletes the local nutrient it senses before diffusion partially
resupplies it — niche construction as a direct spatial-metabolic consequence, not a scripted
trajectory. Confirmed: local footprint glucose concentration peaks at 1.15 (t=2) and falls to
0.94 by t=20, an up-to-~18% local drawdown, while the field-wide glucose total falls by only
~32 of 5940 units — the depletion signature is sharply local to the cell's own footprint and
its immediate diffusive neighborhood, not a field-wide event.

nodes.label: The O2-capped dynamic-FBA mechanism forces the optimizer into mixed-acid acet...
nodes.statement:
The O2-capped dynamic-FBA mechanism forces the optimizer into mixed-acid acetate
overflow (rather than pure aerobic respiration), and that byproduct genuinely diffuses
outward into a spreading plume via spatio-flux's own `DiffusionAdvection` process — the
secretion side of the coupling is as real as the uptake side. Confirmed: field-wide acetate
0 -> ~47.0 over 20 ticks.

nodes.label: A single real CPM cell coupled to a real spatio-flux stressor field through o...
nodes.statement:
A single real CPM cell coupled to a real spatio-flux stressor field through one
coupling process (`CpmDisintegration`) reproduces the paper's §Disintegration level-shift
(Fig 6) as genuine spatial dissolution: the cell holds coherent while the diffusing stressor
field is below its
footprint-local viability bound, then latches a release once that bound is crossed at a
specific, deterministic tick, and its domain resorbs to full dissolution over the following
ticks. Confirmed: area > 30 through tick 6, released_tick == 7.0, area == 0 by tick 16, all
deterministic across repeated runs.

nodes.label: The cell's shed material does not vanish -- it becomes physical debris. As th...
nodes.statement:
The cell's shed material does not vanish -- it becomes physical debris. As the
domain resorbs, its vacated footprint pixels are converted into particles in a shared
map[particle] store, and that debris cloud keeps scattering (RMS spread strictly increasing)
well after the cell itself has fully dissolved, under a separate stock BrownianMovement
process. Confirmed: 68 particles shed by tick 16, RMS spread ~5.3 -> ~7.6 over an 8-tick
post-dissolution window.

nodes.label: The CPM-to-particle bridge this study's disintegration mechanism depends on -...
nodes.statement:
The CPM-to-particle bridge this study's disintegration mechanism depends on --
that a process can emit particles via the map `_add` sentinel into a shared map[particle]
store, and a separate stock movement process can then move them -- is runtime-verified
directly and independently of the disintegration mechanism itself, retiring what was
previously an untested primitive. Confirmed structurally: a synthetic emitter's 3 particles
remain exactly 3 particles four ticks later, with at least 2 having moved under
BrownianMovement.
